default: Existing required exams remain authoritative until independent quality review, complete shadow-bank acceptance, approved mapping and live cross-device acceptance.

grandfathering.passedPriorExam: Retain the stored score, original attempt date and historical required-exam evidence. Do not recalculate old results from a newer answer key.
grandfathering.currentlyInProgress: Continue the originally required exam version by default. Future opt-in transfer requires a dated consent step and unambiguous mapping.
grandfathering.newStudent: Follow existing required exams until a separate authorized activation changes the curriculum requirements.
grandfathering.optionalBanks: V128/V129 optional assessments do not fulfill old required mastery; completion never automatically satisfies required exams.
grandfathering.persistedAnswers: Do not remap question-answer indices, overwrite attempts or delete archived question IDs. Preserve submitted evidence and support rollback.

candidateReview.academic: Independent verification of numerical answers, grading rubrics, difficulty, case relevance, distinctness, business assumptions and option ambiguity.
candidateReview.scope: Review each new candidate exam unit separately, not only total number of questions. Complete 4 distinct required Level 4 sections per course.
candidateReview.sourceIntegrity: Preserve immutable v58/v104 archives and checksum new submissions. Store reviewed final candidate version and reviewer sign-off.
candidateReview.acceptance: Test current and grandfathered mastery, reattempt rules, offline/online synchronization, iPhone PWA/Desktop, restore from account data, and opt-in transition.
candidateReview.activationGate: No new bank is inserted into BAContent.sectionExams or counted as a required exam before all conditions pass.
candidateReview.rollback: Maintain archived old bank in code and leave old grades valid; any future opt-in switch must be reversible without discarding history.
